items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: like John Kirby asked me to come up and play

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And now like did you -- did you -- did many of the bass players around at that time, like say Braud or John Kirby or any of those guys, did they take interest in what you were doing?

Yes, very much. I used to -- oh, whenever I would visit another group, like John Kirby asked me to come up and play, and that's when I did my thing, of course, you know, and quite a few bass players were very interested in
that bowing. They were -- they thought it was fascinating, you know.
